free_tier.stated: a trial at Pro limits that ends at the cap or after 30 days, then the account moves to Free with nothing deleted; a parked workspace uses no compute and keeps its memory and processes

egress.terms: Outbound transfer is a monthly allowance by plan: 100 GB Developer (USD 9), 250 GB Pro (USD 29), 1 TB Startup, 5 TB Scale, and 250 GB during the 7-day signup trial. There is no overage price: at 100 % of the allowance outbound internet traffic is blocked until the next period or an upgrade
